note: Issue #42: Skrugs's speeder stall. Issue #295: this is the square port's (F11 > World > Town), out in the sand past its back gate; the round port uses skrugs_post_round, behind the cantina inside the wall. The 'skrugs_post' landmark in content/core/worlds/port_desert.json picks one per layout, so ships and speeders collide with it and the player walks on it. Local frame: +x faces the town's back gate. 'visual': false = no placeholder box (src/systems/world/speeder_post.gd dresses it). A building's position y lifts it off the sand (the garage roof). The garage is wall pieces, not one box, so a speeder drives in through its open side (+x). 'points': the stall (Skrugs stands behind the counter, the player in front), the display speeder, his garage's bay (where his bench works on a speeder, free roam only), where you stand at the bench, and the spot by the post where he looks at a ship you want to sell him. 'parking': where bought speeders wait, first in the garage, then behind the house; 'nose' is the way each one faces. The jump ramp is its own landmark now (skrugs_ramp).
